dimensions.assessment: Affects employee benefit plans, pharmacy benefit managers, health insurance issuers, and associated service providers.
dimensions.evidence: In the case of a contract or arrangement between a covered plan and a covered service provider for pharmacy benefit management services, no amount of compensation... may be paid

dimensions.assessment: Alters compensation structures and contracting practices for pharmacy benefit management services under ERISA plans.
dimensions.evidence: no amount of compensation (whether direct compensation or indirect compensation) may be paid by such service provider to any individual or entity for... referral, recommendation, placement, retention, or renewal

dimensions.assessment: Potential economic effects on PBM compensation and plan administration costs, though no specific dollar amounts are provided.
Amends a specific section (section 408) of the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974.
dimensions.evidence: To amend section 408 of the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974 to prohibit kickbacks to pharmacy benefit managers.

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory prohibition applying to plan years beginning after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: The amendment made by this section shall apply for plan years beginning after the date of enactment of this Act.

missing_information: Exact financial volume of affected PBM compensation arrangements.
Number of ERISA plans and participants directly impacted.
importance_detail.rationale: Amends the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974 to prohibit pharmacy benefit managers from receiving kickbacks or certain compensation arrangements in covered plans.
